title: Gesture-led column minimap and priority visualizer for virtual tables
creator: Avery Lin
description: This ticket designs an interactive column minimap and column-priority visualizer for Redwood's virtualized table component. The minimap is a condensed horizontal strip that mirrors column widths and allows quick navigation and touch/trackpad gestures to jump to a column cluster. The priority visualizer overlays a heatmap that signals column importance and recommended density collapse candidates, driven by token-density heuristics. Deliverables: high-fidelity mockups, interactive prototype (touch + keyboard), and handoff tokens/variants to engineering.
acceptance_criteria: Figma mocks for desktop, tablet, and mobile narrow-width with minimap visible and collapsed states
Interactive prototype demonstrating gesture pan-to-jump, tap-to-focus, and keyboard equivalents (arrow + home/end)
Accessibility spec describing ARIA roles, announcements for minimap navigation, and reduced-motion fallback
Performance constraints documented: minimap rendering must not increase table render time >5% and must work with virtualized row pools
Design tokens and CSS vars documented for minimap height, gutter, heatmap color stops, and collapsed affordances
Handoff package with annotations for engineering on pixel snapping, KV-cache considerations, and telemetry hooks
design_notes: Research showed users with wide tables prefer a compact overview to reorient quickly; the minimap balances overview with low visual noise. Key constraints: must not replicate full DOM for columns (use canvas or lightweight divs), must gracefully degrade when virtualization hides many columns, and thumb gestures need hit-targets >=44px. Heatmap intensity maps to token-density and recent interaction frequency. Telemetry knobs: capture minimap opens, jumps, and toggles for A/B. Clarify interaction around pinned columns: pinned columns should be represented pinned-to-left in minimap with a persistent anchor. Edge cases: column resize while minimap open, column groups, and column virtualization swaps during live scrolling.
decisions: Prototype will implement the minimap as a canvas layer for performance but expose CSS variables for theming. Keyboard mode will mirror gesture behavior with a focus ring navigator overlay. Heatmap algorithm will initially use a simple token-density percentile mapped to three color stops (low/medium/high) and can be refined after telemetry collection.
